claims.summary: Coset ratio reduction: in lem:local-tuple-ratio's window (charged character pseudoideal, e_max+K<=D, K+tau+|supp gamma_i|<=D), for a tuple whose components E_i=P_i m_(gamma_i) have P_i functions of the states of one edge set T (any incidence), with R_j the span of the images of E_i g over T-characters g of support <=j and r_j=dim R_j: (i) c(k) <= r_tau q_T(k) for k<=K, r_tau for one component the number of compatible labels where it is nonzero (at most 3^(tau-dim B_T)); (ii) if c(K)>0, for 0<=J<=K with r_J>0, c(K-d)/c(K) <= (r_tau/r_J) q_T(K-d)/q_T(K-J) = (r_tau/r_J) h_(G-T)(K-d)/h_(G-T)(K-J) (lem:pin-rank-transfer (b)), with r_tau/r_J=1 at J=j*, the least j with r_j=r_tau. (i) groups lem:local-tuple-ratio's translates by cosets of B+W, using lem:cut-code-classes; it is the decomposition into conjunctions with the exact count.
claims.assessment: Working elementary proof; the conjunction decomposition is a recorded remark, the reduction of the ratio to the residual graph's two-level coset counts the new part.
claims.rationale: Reduces the open short-range ratio question for components of high incidence to a two-level coset count of the residual graph.
claims.next_action: Bound the residual two-level coset ratio for graphs that are expanders apart from low-degree vertices.
